day.headline: A Rooster day — Ox and Snake are in step.

reasons: Ox and Rooster share a triad — strong alignment today
signs.message: Fifteen minutes till they lock up. Go, the aisles are yours.

reasons: Dragon pairs with Rooster — a harmonious day
signs.message: The fix you bodged in July still holds. Trust that instinct.

reasons: Snake and Rooster share a triad — strong alignment today
signs.motif: a voice heard through a wall
signs.message: Someone's laughing through the wall. Go find that room tonight.

reasons: Dog sits apart from Rooster — the day is yours to steer
signs.motif: a table you have to wait for
signs.message: Put your name down and wait. That table's worth the standing.

reasons: Monkey sits apart from Rooster — the day is yours to steer
signs.message: They've rolled over half of it. Go photograph what's still there.

reasons: Rabbit opposes Rooster — a day to take slowly
signs.motif: an opinion you have not voiced
signs.message: You've been sitting on that take all week. Voice it casually.

reasons: Tiger sits apart from Rooster — the day is yours to steer
signs.message: The rock from that beach. Put it where you'll see it.

reasons: Horse sits apart from Rooster — the day is yours to steer
signs.motif: a group where you say least
signs.message: You're the quiet one in that chat. Say one real thing.

reasons: Pig sits apart from Rooster — the day is yours to steer
signs.message: No autopsy needed. Let it stay warm and low-effort today.

reasons: Goat sits apart from Rooster — the day is yours to steer
signs.message: Ads and all, the cheap tier's fine tonight. Stay in.

reasons: Rooster's own day — your energy runs high
signs.message: Wallet still won't close. It's survived this long, leave it.

reasons: Rat sits apart from Rooster — the day is yours to steer
signs.motif: a dinner that took too long
signs.message: Three hours at that table last night. Tonight, eat standing up.
